name: yuzora
description: 青空文庫のテキストファイル（.txt）やXHTMLファイル（.html）をブラウザへドラッグ＆ドロップするだけで、美しい縦書き表示に変換し、快適に読書ができるクライアントサイド専用の静的Web SPAビューアーです。

scripts.test:unit: node --test tests/unit/core/yuzora.test.js tests/unit/parser/parser.test.js tests/unit/core/locator.test.js tests/unit/core/commands.test.js tests/unit/core/diagnostics.test.js tests/unit/ui/renderer.test.js tests/unit/core/event.test.js tests/unit/storage/repository.test.js tests/unit/ui/scene.test.js tests/unit/core/router.test.js tests/unit/storage/resource.test.js tests/unit/ui/placeholder.test.js
scripts.test:e2e:compiled: npm run test:cleanup && TEST_PATH=/compiled.html playwright test
scripts.test:coverage: node --experimental-test-coverage --test tests/unit/core/yuzora.test.js tests/unit/parser/parser.test.js tests/unit/core/locator.test.js tests/unit/core/commands.test.js tests/unit/core/diagnostics.test.js tests/unit/ui/renderer.test.js tests/unit/core/event.test.js tests/unit/storage/repository.test.js tests/unit/ui/scene.test.js tests/unit/core/router.test.js tests/unit/storage/resource.test.js tests/unit/ui/placeholder.test.js
scripts.test:vrt: npm run test:cleanup && playwright test tests/e2e/vrt.spec.js
scripts.healthcheck: make && npm run test:unit && npm run test:traceability && npm run test:types && npm run lint
scripts.test: npm run lint && npm run test:types && npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:e2e:compiled
